source: The Panel and the Plan, 18 September 2026

chair.does: Aggregates, names outstanding vetoes, and writes one paragraph on where the panel split.
chair.note: The split is the interesting part. Unanimity at 8 is competence. A 9.5 from the Cold Reader against a 6 from the Sceptic is the conversation worth having.

judges.name: The Preacher-Catcher
judges.asks: Does any sentence tell the reader what to conclude, believe or become?
judges.catches: Closing morals, lessons for leaders, the final line reaching for significance, any sentence that would work on a conference slide.
judges.forbidden: Everything else. This judge reads for one thing.

judges.name: The Fact Checker
judges.asks: Who produced this number, when, counting what?
judges.catches: Unattributed figures, aggregator reporting passed off as primary, a statistic that has drifted from its source, a quote tidied into something nobody said.
judges.forbidden: Whether the argument is any good.

judges.name: The Cold Reader
judges.asks: After fifteen seconds, can you say what this is about and why it matters to you?
judges.catches: Warm-ups, buried leads, assumed context, cleverness that costs comprehension.

judges.name: The Art Director
judges.asks: Does the picture carry the argument, or decorate it?
judges.catches: Diagrams that restate the text, labels naming values the chart never reaches, thumbnails that die small, three pieces that look like three publications.
judges.forbidden: Copy. May say a headline does not sit, never rewrite it.

judges.name: The Line Editor
judges.asks: Would a good editor let this line through?
judges.catches: AI tells, em dashes, banned vocabulary, passive voice hiding the actor, uniform paragraphs, the tricolon reflex.

judges.name: The Sceptic
judges.asks: What would a well-informed person who disagrees say, and does this survive it?
judges.catches: Straw men, cherry-picked evidence, a verdict the evidence does not carry, an antagonist too weak to be worth beating.

judges.name: The Distribution Judge
judges.asks: Does this survive a thumbnail, a muted autoplay and a collapsed first line?
judges.catches: Headlines needing their subtitle, shorts whose point lives in the audio, empty opening frames, a title that fits any piece on the subject.

judges.name: The Continuity Judge
judges.asks: Have we said this, contradicted this, or used this angle before?
judges.catches: Repeated arguments, a verdict quietly reversing an earlier one, a theme tracked inconsistently, diagram language drifting.

judges.name: The Agency Judge
judges.asks: Does a reader finish more capable of judging for themselves, or merely better informed?
judges.catches: Handing over a conclusion instead of the means to reach one, evidence the reader cannot check, a your.call question with an obvious right answer.
judges.forbidden: Demanding the mission be stated. The Preacher-Catcher overrules them on that, deliberately.

judges.name: The Commissioner
judges.asks: Against everything else we could have run this week, was this the right use of the day?
judges.catches: Competent pieces that should not exist, an idea that scored well and delivered thinly, a broad-coverage piece posing as a signature one.
judges.forbidden: Craft, evidence and pictures. No veto: opportunity cost is Krish's call.

gates.trigger: Any draft at first complete state
Anything published elsewhere under his name
